question: What rite performed at the half-year is linked with the annual observance?
premises: A rite is performed at the half-year mark.
An annual rite is also recognized.
The half-year rite is joined with the annual observance.
inference: The rite performed at six months is associated with the annual śrāddha observance.
uncertainties: The exact manner of conjunction between the half-year and annual rites is not fully specified.
